svg.aria-label: Fetch, cycle by cycle, and the three redirect tiers
svg.text: Fetch, cycle by cycle, and the three redirect tiers
One fetch group per cycle. The next fetch predictor answers in one cycle; the slower predictors check it two cycles later; decode and execute check again.
Seven cycles of one fetch group
spans are what each unit does in that cycle
Next fetch predictor entry, as inferred from the fetch group behaviour
PC bits used by the zero bubble tier
full history lookup, compared with the NFP answer
L0 miss: target from the L1I line
finds an unpredicted branch, fixes the length
resolves: 13 cycles back to fetch in all
L0 hit: the next PC is ready for cycle 1, zero bubble
cycle 3 restart: the L1 tier, or a slow predictor that disagrees
a hit gives target, length and end type
len: up to 16 instructions, one 64 B line, cut at the first taken branch
end type: conditional, unconditional, call, return (RAS target), indirect (ITTAGE target)
way: the L1I way to read; tag and iTLB skipped (patent)
mask: the slow predictors this group needs (patent)
written by the slow predictors on disagreement
strong-set newcomers go to a FIFO overflow table
a non-branch at a trained PC redirects fetch
the tag does not cover the whole PC
a hit is checked against the bytes at decode
512 sets × 2 ways = 1024 entries: PC 10:2 picks a set, the ways cover 4 KiB
inside 4 KiB a taken branch is free; beyond, two bubbles
about 8192 L1 entries: one target per 24 B of the 192 KiB, or a side table; open
the L0 BTB is the fetch group table itself
branches 2 KiB apart share a set
test: three taken branches exactly 2 KiB apart
no trace cache on the M1
depth open; a guess of at least 120
loop buffer source, no timing change
skipped short forward branch bodies deleted
NOP and B: no issue slot, one retire slot
shifted ALU op: one uop, issues twice
LDP: one uop, two register writes
pre- and post-index: an extra base uop
store: address uop and data uop
fusion pairs marked here, merged at map
small fetch stack for early returns
overflow clears the stack; call cost jumps
PAC bits checked at push and pop
